original_test_intent: Validate Device Type Instance as a stable, owner-approved identifier unique within the onboard LAN device-type group, so multiple LAN records cannot be omitted, duplicated or silently swapped across reboot.
original_method: Length-check all Type 41 records, retain raw type and instance bytes, group by decoded device type, verify policy-defined uniqueness/gaps and bind each instance to designation plus PCI BDF before/after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies instance numbering/group policy and approves reboot; the grouping and identity comparison are automated.
required_inputs: Expected instance per onboard LAN identity and decoded device-type group
Start, gap, duplicate and absent-record policy
Approved reboot with recovery independent of tested LAN
safety_requirements: Do not reorder, rename, enable/disable, reset or reconfigure LAN devices.
Define uniqueness within each decoded Device Type group, not globally or by output row order.
Bind instance values to stable designation/BDF/PCI identity before comparing reboot captures.
Stop on network/management recovery failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate length/raw type/instance, build per-type groups, check policy-defined uniqueness/gaps and compare each identity-bound instance across reboot.
Report duplicate, missing, swapped, regrouped or drifting instances without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the grouping, numbering/gap and physical-to-PCI instance map plus reboot plan.
Adjudicate intentional gaps/firmware renumbering and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but a grep cannot establish grouping scope, uniqueness, record identity or detect an instance-to-BDF swap.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 41 and emit type group, instance, designation, BDF/PCI identity, uniqueness/gap result and pre/post mapping diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Device Type Instance scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no device ordering/state change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Group raw instance bytes by decoded Type 41 device type, enforce owner numbering/uniqueness policy and compare identity-bound maps rather than row order across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing multiple Type 41 onboard LAN records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, board/BIOS, parser/dmidecode, kernel and PCI versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 41 Device Type Instance definition plus owner onboard-device topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds correct uniqueness scope, gap rules and stable BDF/board ownership.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects duplicates, omissions, type-group changes and silent instance swaps hidden by a list of values.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An instance is local to a type group, not a universal PCI identifier; BDF/board evidence is required to establish continuity.

project_override_considerations: Projects may permit gaps or choose a numbering start, but must record the rule and cannot use list order as identity or alter devices to force numbering.
expected_evidence: Approved per-type LAN instance and gap/duplicate policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 41 raw type/instance with handles/lengths
Per-type grouping, uniqueness/gap analysis and designation/BDF/PCI mapping
Statement that no LAN identity/state/configuration changed
Approved reboot/network/OOB record and identity-bound post-reboot map diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Device Type Instance is a valid Type 41 field; uniqueness scope and expected mapping are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Grouping, uniqueness and stable-identity comparison are fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds type-group scope, uniqueness/gap and stable PCI ownership.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its anti-row-order safeguard while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates numbering topology/reboot readiness and formal verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Detects silent swaps and omissions that would pass if instance bytes were merely printed or assumed to follow record order.
independent_technical_reasoning: Instance numbering is a relation within a device-type set; correctness requires group-scoped uniqueness and stable mapping to the same physical/PCI LAN identity.
